full_name: Bahman Khodadadi | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Law Robert G. James Scholar Fellow Independent Scholar
bio: Bahman Khodadadi is a scholar of law and Islamic studies with expertise in Shiite Islamic jurisprudence, criminal law theory, and the politico-juridical dynamics of the Middle East. He recently published On Theocratic Criminal Law: The Rule of Religion and Punishment in Iran (Oxford University Press, 2024), and his scholarship appears in such journals as Iranian Studies and the Yale Journal of Law & the Humanities.
